parameters.description:
`msg-to-smtp2go-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SMTP2Go destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own SMTP2Go destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional SMTP2Go destinations bound per enrollment.

Create a free account at smtp2go.com, then generate an API key from Settings → API Keys in your dashboard and set it as SMTP2GO_EMAIL_APIKEY. Set your verified sending address as SMTP2GO_FROM and the recipient's address as SMTP2GO_TO.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SMTP2GO destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to SMTP2GO v3 email/send
parameters.summary: Send an email to your own SMTP2Go destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SMTP2Go apikey

from_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SMTP2GO_FROM value (same format as SMTP2GO_FROM)

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SMTP2GO_TO value (same format as SMTP2GO_TO)
